phase: 11 WI-5 Job B — HCV NS5B NI with property-UNMATCHED decoys
decoy_recipe: ChEMBL drug-like (MW 250-500, ≤1 Ro5 violation), phosphate-free, scaffold-distinct — deliberately property-UNMATCHED to the charged triphosphate actives (Stein 2021 DUDE-Z philosophy). DeepCoy absent.
interpretation: This benchmark DOES run with a property-unmatched recipe (unlike the property-matched recipe, which could not build a decoy set). Read the numbers with the DUDE-Z caveat: high enrichment against neutral drug-like decoys may reflect charge/size discrimination of the triphosphate actives rather than pocket-specific binding — the paired Vina-vs-2D-similarity test separates those. Reported as-is.
